護甲（輕甲、中甲、或重甲），珍稀（需同調）
這套奇形怪狀的黑白色調護甲鑄成於 墮影冥界Shadowfell 之中，它充滿着那個可怕位面的幽影能量。
穿着這套護甲期間，你爲防止陷入或結束 恐慌Frightened 狀態所做的豁免具有優勢。
這套護甲具有3發充能。你可以消耗一發充能以用其施展法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.6MYwBtZurc8Zw1ac]{安定心神 Calm Emotions}（豁免DC15）。這套護甲在每日黎明時分恢復[[/r 1d3]]發已消耗的充能數。

This intricate grayscale armor was forged in the Shadowfell and is infused with that plane's gloom.

While you're wearing this armor, you have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the frightened condition on yourself.

This armor has 3 charges. You can expend a charge to cast the @spell[Calm Emotions] spell (save DC 15) from the armor. This armor regains [[/r 1d3]] expended charges daily at dawn.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Breastplate|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Breastplate|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Mail|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Chain Mail|BMT])
  • @item[Chain Shirt|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Chain Shirt|BMT])
  • @item[Half Plate Armor|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Half Plate Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Hide Armor|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Hide Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Leather Armor|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Leather Armor|BMT])

  • @item[Splint Armor|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Splint Armor|BMT])
  • @item[Studded Leather Armor|PHB] (@item[Gloomwrought Studded Leather Armor|BMT])
